title: DECLARE 121 EVERY MORNING AND WATCH GOD WORK WONDERS IN YOUR LIFE
text: Beloved, I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are, whether you are in your bedroom, in your car, in your office, or wherever this word has found you. I want you to understand something. What I am about to share with you this morning is not just another motivational speech. This is a prophetic word from the throne room of grace. There is a dimension of divine intervention that is activated when the people of God begin to align themselves with the eternal word of God. And I tell you, Psalm 121 is not just a passage of scripture, it is a covenant charter, it is a legal document in the spirit realm, it is a prophetic declaration that shifts atmospheres. The Bible says in Psalm 121:1, "I will lift up mine eyes onto the hills from whence cometh my help." Now, many people read this scripture casually, but beloved, there is a depth here that will transform [music] your life. When the psalmist says, "I will lift up mine eyes," he's making a deliberate choice. He's not looking at his circumstances, he's not looking at the giants in his land, he's not looking at the impossibilities that surround him. He's making a prophetic declaration of focus. Your focus determines your reality. What you behold, you become. Where you look determines what you attract. And so this morning, I want to prophesy over your life. Every distraction that has been stealing your focus, I command it to be removed by fire. Every situation that has made you look down instead of up, every disappointment that has made you fix your gaze on earth instead of heaven, I decree and declare supernatural reversal in the name of Jesus. You will lift up your eyes again. You will look onto the hills. You will look beyond your present circumstance into the realm of divine possibilities. Now, watch this carefully. The psalmist says, "From whence cometh my help." He asked the question because he understood something about the spiritual realm. Not all help is divine help. Not all assistance comes from God. There are dimensions of help that come with strings attached. There are levels of breakthrough that come with bondage attached to them. But when your help comes from the Lord, it comes with no sorrow added. Proverbs 10:22 says the blessing of the Lord it make it rich and he added no sorrow with it. So this morning, I want you to be very clear about where your help is coming from. Some of you have been running to the wrong hills. Some of you have been looking to man for what only God can do. Some of you have been trusting in the arm of flesh and God is saying this morning, redirect your focus, look onto me. I am the source. I am the [music] fountain. I am the wellspring of every good and perfect gift. And then verse two becomes the answer to the question. My help cometh from the Lord which made heaven and earth. Now this is profound. This is not just any Lord. This is not a territorial deity. This is not a limited God. This is the Lord Yahweh, Jehovah, the self-existent one. The one who made heaven and earth. The implications of this are staggering. If your help comes from the one who made heaven and earth, it means your help is unlimited. [music] It means your help is boundless. It means there is no situation too difficult for the one who is helping you. Think about this. The same God who spoke galaxies into existence, the same God who commanded light to shine out of darkness, the same God who separated the waters from the dry land, the same God who set the sun in its orbit and the moon in its path. That is the God from whom your help is coming. So tell me, what problem in your life is too big for [music] him? What challenge in your business is beyond his capacity? What sickness in your body can stand before the God who formed your frame in your mother's womb? I prophesy over someone this morning. Your help is not coming from your connection, it is coming from the Lord. Your help is not coming from your academic qualification, it is coming from the Lord. Your help is not coming from your ancestral lineage, it is coming from the Lord who made heaven and earth. And because your help comes from him, it shall be comprehensive, it shall be timely, it shall be supernatural, and it shall leave a testimony. In the name of Jesus. Verse three says, "He will not suffer thy foot to be moved. He that keepeth thee will not slumber." Now, I want you to understand the depth of this covenant promise. When God says he will not suffer your foot to be moved, he's speaking about stability. He's speaking about security. He's speaking about divine preservation. In a world where everything is shaking, where foundations are being destroyed, where securities are failing and investments are crashing, God is saying, "I will give you supernatural stability." The word moved here means to sleep, to stumble, to fall. God is saying, "I will establish your steps, I will order your path, I will keep you from falling into the traps of the enemy." Every pit that has been dug for you, you shall not fall into it. Every snare that has been set on your path, you shall not be caught by it. Every stumbling block that the enemy has positioned in your way, you shall leap over it by the power of the Holy Ghost. And then watch this. "He that keepeth thee will not slumber." This is where the assurance becomes complete. Your God does not sleep. Your God does [music] not take a break. Your God does not go on vacation. While you are sleeping, he's watching. While you are unconscious, he's conscious of everything concerning you. The enemy may plot in the night, but your God does not sleep in the night. Demons may conspire in darkness, but your God sees in the darkness as clearly as in the light. Verse 4 reinforces this. Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. The word behold is a call to attention. God is saying, "Look at this. Pay attention to this. Meditate on this reality. Your keeper does not sleep." This is not just poetry. This is a prophetic reality. There is a divine watch over your life that never ceases, that never diminishes, that never relaxes. And I declare over you this morning, because your God does not sleep, every attack that comes against you in the night shall [music] fail. Every plan that the enemy hatches while you are resting shall be frustrated. Every conspiracy that is formed in darkness against your destiny shall be exposed and destroyed. The sleepless one is watching over you, and no weapon formed against you shall prosper. Now, I need you to stay with me because verses 5 to 8 are going to revolutionize your prayer life. Verse 5 says, "The Lord is thy keeper." "The Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand." There are multiple dimensions of protection here. First, he is your keeper. The word keeper means guardian, protector, one who watches over. But then he adds another dimension. He is your shade upon your right hand. In the ancient Near East, the right hand was the position of authority, the position of power, the position of action. When God says he is your shade upon your right hand, he is saying, "I am protecting your place of authority. I am covering your place of [music] power. I am shielding your effectiveness." The enemy may try to attack your influence, but God is your shade. The enemy may try to diminish your impact, but God is your covering. And the word shade is significant. In a hot desert climate, shade is not a luxury, it is a necessity. Shade is what keeps you alive. Shade is what preserves your strength. God is saying, "I am not just protecting you from the enemy's attacks. I am preserving your strength. [music] I am maintaining your vitality. I am keeping you fresh even in seasons of intense heat." Verse 6 says, "The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night." Now, many people read this as merely physical protection, but there are deeper spiritual realities here. The sun represents the obvious attacks, the visible challenges, the things you can see coming. But, the moon represents the hidden attacks, the occult operations, the things that happen in the realm of darkness, the spiritual wickedness in high places. God is saying, "I will protect you from both, the attacks you can see and the attacks you cannot see. I will shield you from all of them." The conspiracies that are formed in broad daylight and the covenants that are activated at midnight, none of them shall prosper >> [music] >> against you. You are covered both by day and by night. You are protected both in the natural and in the supernatural. >> [music] >> I prophesy to someone, every assignment of darkness against your life is canceled. [music] Every monitoring spirit that has been watching you, I command it to go blind in the name of Jesus. Every evil altar where your name has been mentioned, I command that altar to catch fire. Every coven where decisions have been made against your destiny, I scatter that gathering by the fire of the Holy Ghost. You shall not be smitten by day or by night. Verse 7 is powerful. The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul. The word preserve means to guard, to protect, [music] to keep in a state of safety. And notice the comprehensiveness, from all evil. Not some evil, not most evil, all evil. This is a total coverage. This is a complete insurance. This is a comprehensive protection. And then he adds, "He shall preserve [music] thy soul." Your soul is your mind, your will, your emotions. God is saying, "I will protect your mental health. I will guard your emotional stability. I will preserve your psychological wholeness." In a generation where depression is rising, where anxiety is increasing, where mental health issues are becoming epidemic, God is saying, [music] "I will preserve your soul." Every spirit of depression, I bind you now in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of anxiety, I command you to lose your hold. Every spirit of fear, I cast you out by the authority of the name of Jesus. Every tormenting thought, every negative imagination, every evil suggestion, I pull down by the power of the Holy Ghost. Your soul shall be preserved. Your mind shall be kept in perfect peace. Your emotions shall be stabilized by the power of God. And then verse 8 brings us to the climax. "The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth and even forevermore." This is not just protection for today. This is not just covering for this week. This is not just security for this year. This is eternal preservation. This is perpetual protection. From this time forth and even forevermore. Your going out, that is your ventures, your journeys, your businesses, your initiatives, your new beginnings, your coming in, that is your returns, your harvests, your rewards, your celebrations, God is saying, "I will protect both. I will cover you when you are starting and when you are finishing. I will guard you when you are planting and when you are harvesting. I will shield you when you are going and when you are returning." Now, this is why I said at the beginning that you must declare Psalm 121 every morning. Because when you speak this word over your life, you are not just saying nice religious words. You are activating covenant promises. You are releasing prophetic declarations. You are setting spiritual laws in motion. You are aligning yourself with divine realities that transcend the natural realm. And please, I want you to do something for me right now. I want you to share this message with someone. Don't keep this to yourself. There is somebody in your contact list who needs to hear this word. There is someone in your family who needs this prophetic activation. There is a friend, a colleague, a neighbor who needs to understand the power of declaring Psalm 121. When you share this word, you are not just forwarding a message, you are becoming a channel of blessing. >> [music] >> You are becoming an agent of transformation. You are partnering with the Holy Spirit to change someone's life. You see, the scripture says in Isaiah 55:11, "So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please. And it shall prosper in the thing whereunto I sent it." Every time you declare God's word, you are sending it forth on assignment. You are releasing it to accomplish specific purposes. You are activating it to prosper in specific areas of your life. So when you wake up in the morning and you begin to declare Psalm 121, you are not just reading scripture, >> [music] >> you are prophesying your day. You are setting the spiritual atmosphere. You are establishing the tone for everything that will happen. You are taking authority over the hours ahead. You are claiming divine protection before you step into the arena of daily challenges. And let me tell you something. The enemy understands the power of words. The enemy knows that life and death are in the power of the tongue. The enemy is aware that the worlds were framed by the word of God. That is why the enemy fights so hard to keep believers ignorant of the authority they carry in their words. That is why the devil works overtime to keep God's people speaking negatively, confessing defeat, declaring impossibility. But I'm here to tell you this morning, you have the power to change your reality through your words. You have the authority to shift your circumstances through your declarations. You have the capacity to alter your destiny through your confessions. And when you begin to declare Psalm 121 every morning, you are exercising that authority, you are wielding that power, you are manifesting that capacity. Now, let me show you something profound. The entire Psalm 121 is built on a progression. It starts with a question, "From whence cometh my help?" Then it moves to a declaration, "My help cometh from the Lord." Then it expands into promises, "He will not suffer thy foot to be moved." And it culminates in eternal assurance, "From this time forth and even forevermore." This is the pattern of faith. Faith begins with inquiry, faith moves into declaration, faith expands into expectation, and faith culminates in assurance. When you declare this Psalm, you are walking through this entire journey. You are moving from uncertainty to certainty, from questioning to confession, from hoping to knowing. And I want you to understand, there are dimensions of God's protection that are only activated by your declaration. There are levels of divine covering that are only released when you speak them. God has already made the provision, but you must make the proclamation. Heaven has already established the reality, but you must [music] declare the decree. Job 22:28 says, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." The word decree means to authoritatively declare, to officially pronounce, to legally establish. When you decree Psalm 121 over your life, you are not begging God to protect you. You are declaring what he has already promised. You are establishing in the earthly realm what he has already ordained in the heavenly realm. Some of you have been praying weak prayers. Some of you have been making timid confessions. Some of you have been speaking with uncertainty and doubt. But this morning God is raising up a generation of believers who will speak with authority. A generation who will declare with confidence. A generation who will prophesy [music] with boldness. And I want to pray with you right now. I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are. I don't care if you're in a public place. I don't care if people are watching you. This is between you and your God. Lift up your hands right now as a sign of your surrender, as a symbol of your reception, as a demonstration of your expectation. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace with [music] boldness. I come as a representative of every person who is hearing this word. I come as an intercessor standing in the gap. And Lord, I thank you that Psalm 121 is not just ancient poetry. It is a living word. It is a present [music] reality. It is an active covenant. And so right now in the name of Jesus, I decree that every person hearing this word, their help is coming from you, the Lord who made heaven and earth. I declare that their help is not limited by human capacity. I declare that their help is not restricted by natural circumstances. I declare that their help is supernatural. It is abundant. It is timely. It is comprehensive. I decree over them that their foot shall not be moved. Every trap of the enemy, they shall not fall into it. Every snare of the devil, they shall escape it. Every pit that has been dug for them, they shall leap over it by the power of the Holy Ghost. Their steps are ordered by the Lord, and they shall walk in divine stability. I declare that you, the Lord their keeper, neither slumber nor sleep. While they rest, you are watching. While they are unconscious, you are conscious of everything concerning them. Every midnight attack is cancelled. Every nocturnal operation against them is frustrated. Every dream manipulation is terminated. They shall sleep in peace and wake in victory. I decree that you are their shade upon their right hand. Their authority is covered. Their power is protected. Their effectiveness is shielded. The sun shall not smite them by day. Every visible attack shall fail. The moon shall not smite them by night. Every hidden conspiracy shall be exposed and destroyed. Lord, I ask you to preserve them from all evil. Every evil intention, I cancel it. Every evil plan, I frustrate it. Every evil covenant, I break it. Every evil pronouncement, I reverse it. Every evil assignment, I terminate it in the name of Jesus. They shall be preserved from all evil. I declare that you preserve their soul. Their mind is protected. [music] Their emotions are guarded. Their will is strengthened. Every spirit of depression, lose your hold now. Every spirit of anxiety, I bind you. Every tormenting thought, I cast you out. Their souls shall be preserved in perfect peace. And finally, Lord, I decree over them that you preserve their going out and their coming in from this time forth and even forevermore. Every journey they embark on, you shall protect them. Every venture they begin, you shall prosper them. Every seed they plant, you shall multiply it. Every harvest they reap, you shall preserve it. I declare that this is not temporary protection, this is eternal preservation. This is not seasonal covering, this is perpetual security. From this moment forward and throughout eternity, they are kept by the power of God. No weapon formed against them shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against them in judgment, they shall condemn. This is their heritage as servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of you, oh God. Now, I want you to begin to declare this for yourself. Don't just receive what I am praying, participate in this prayer. Open your mouth and begin to declare Psalm 121 over your life. Don't whisper it, declare it. Don't mumble it, proclaim it. Don't doubt it, believe it. Say it with me. I will lift up mine eyes onto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth. He will not suffer my foot to be moved. He that keepeth me will not slumber. Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. The Lord is my keeper. The Lord is my shade upon my right hand. The sun shall not smite me by day, nor the moon by night. The Lord shall preserve me from all evil. He shall preserve my soul. The Lord shall preserve my going out and my coming in from this time forth and even forevermore. Now, declare it again with more faith. My help cometh from the Lord. He will not suffer my foot to be moved. He is my keeper. He is my shade. I am preserved from all evil. My soul is preserved. My going out and my coming in are preserved from this time forth and even forevermore. Can you feel the shift in the atmosphere? Can you sense the release in the spirit realm? This is what happens when the people of God begin to declare his word with faith. This is what happens when believers stop begging and start decreeing. This is what happens when the saints of God understand their authority and begin to exercise it. And let me tell you something that will transform your prayer life. Every morning when you wake up before you check your phone, before you read the news, before you engage with the challenges of the day, spend time declaring Psalm 121. Make it your daily confession. Make it your morning anthem. Make it your prophetic proclamation. Because here is what will happen when you consistently declare God's word over your life, you begin to build a spiritual fortress around yourself. You begin to establish a protective atmosphere around your family. You begin to create a victorious environment around your business. The word of God becomes a shield, a covering, a defense system that the enemy cannot penetrate. Proverbs 4:22 says, "My son, attend to my words, incline thine ear unto my sayings. Let them not depart from thine eyes, keep them in the midst of thine heart. For they are life unto those that find them and health to all their flesh." When you keep God's word before your eyes, when you keep it in your heart, when you keep it in your mouth, it becomes life to you. It becomes health to your flesh. It becomes a source of supernatural vitality. And I want to prophesy to someone right now. There is someone hearing this word who has been under attack. There is someone who has been experiencing unusual challenges, unexplainable setbacks, unprecedented difficulties. And God is saying to you this morning, "The season of attack is over. The period of harassment is terminated. The time of struggle is ended." As you begin to declare Psalm 121 every morning, you are activating a new dimension of protection. You are stepping into a new level of preservation. You are entering a new realm of divine security. The enemy will not be able to touch you the way he has been touching you. The devil will not be able to harass you the way he has been harassing you. The forces of darkness will not be able to intimidate you the way they have been intimidating you. Because when God says from this time forth, he's drawing a line in the spirit realm, he's marking a new beginning, he's establishing a new season. Everything that happened before this moment is in the [music] past. Everything that the enemy did before this declaration is history. From this time forth, you are stepping into a new dimension of divine intervention. And even forevermore, that means this protection extends into eternity. This preservation is not just for time, it is for eternity. This covering is not just for your natural life, it is for your eternal destiny. God is not just protecting you for a few years, he's securing you for all of eternity. Now, I know some of you are thinking, "But man of God, I've declared scriptures before and things didn't change." Let me tell you why. Declaration without expectation is just noise. Confession without faith is just religious exercise. Speaking the word without believing the word is just empty repetition. Hebrews 4:2 says, "For unto us was the gospel [music] preached, as well as unto them. But the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it." The word must be mixed with faith. Your declaration must be accompanied by expectation. Your confession must be saturated with belief. So, when you declare Psalm 121 every morning, don't just say the words mechanically, say them [music] with conviction, say them with expectation, say them with faith. See yourself protected. See yourself preserved. See yourself covered. Visualize the shield of God around you. Imagine the angels of God encamped around your dwelling. Picture the hand of God upon your life. Because faith is not just mental agreement, faith is spiritual sight. Faith is seen in the realm of the spirit what has not yet manifested in the realm of the natural. Faith is calling those things that be not as though they were. Faith is being fully persuaded that what God has promised he is able also to perform. And I declare over you this morning, your faith is being activated, your spiritual sight is being opened, your prophetic vision is being released. You shall no longer see through the lens of doubt, you shall see through the lens of faith. You shall no longer speak through the vocabulary of defeat, you shall speak through the vocabulary of victory. You shall no longer walk in the consciousness of limitation, you shall walk in the consciousness of divine possibility. Let me give you a practical testimony. There was a time in my life when I was facing intense spiritual warfare. The attacks were relentless, the pressure was overwhelming, the challenges were unprecedented. And God led me to begin declaring Psalm 91 and Psalm 121 every morning. Not just reading them but declaring them with faith, speaking them with [music] authority, proclaiming them with conviction. And I began to see a transformation. The atmosphere around my life began to shift, the attacks began to diminish, the pressure began to ease, the challenges began to resolve. Not because the enemy stopped attacking, but because I had activated a dimension of divine protection that made me untouchable. Not because the warfare ceased, but because I had stepped into a realm of preservation that made me invincible. And this is what God wants to do for you. He wants to take you from being a victim of circumstances to being a victor through Christ. He wants to move you from being tossed by every wind of doctrine to being established in the word of God. He wants to shift you from being intimidated by the enemy to being fortified by the spirit of God. But it requires consistency. It requires discipline. It requires commitment. You cannot declare Psalm 121 for 2 days and then stop when you don't see immediate results. You cannot confess the word for a week and then give up when the challenges persist. [music] You must be steadfast. You must be unmovable. You must be always abounding in the work of the Lord. 1 Corinthians 15:58 says, "Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye steadfast, unmovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord. For as much as you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord. Your labor of declaring God's word is not in vain. Your effort of speaking divine promises is not wasted. Your consistency in confessing scriptural truth is not futile. Every word you speak is a seed. Every declaration you make is a deposit. Every confession you utter is an investment. And in due season, you shall reap if you faint not. In the appointed time, you shall harvest if you give not up. In the proper moment, you shall see the manifestation if you remain steadfast. Now, let me pray one more prayer with you. This time, I want you to pray it out loud with me. I want you to engage your voice. I want you to activate your authority. Are you ready? Say this. Father, I thank you for your word. I thank you that your word is alive. I thank you that your word is powerful. I thank you that your word is effective. I receive Psalm 121 as my daily confession. I receive it as my morning declaration. I receive it as my prophetic proclamation. From this day forward, I will lift up my eyes onto the hills. I will look beyond my circumstances. I will see beyond my challenges. I will focus on you, are source of my help. My help comes from you, the Lord who made heaven and earth. My help is not limited, my help is not restricted, my help is supernatural and abundant. You will not suffer my foot to be moved. I am established, I am secured, I am stabilized. Every trap of the enemy shall fail. Every snare of the devil shall be broken. Every pit dug for me shall be filled. You are my keeper and you neither slumber nor sleep. While I rest, you watch. While I sleep, you guard. While I am unconscious, you are fully aware of everything concerning me. You are my shade upon my right hand. My authority is covered, my power is protected, my influence is shielded. The sun shall not smite me by day, every visible attack shall fail. The moon shall not smite me by night, every hidden conspiracy shall be exposed and destroyed. You preserve me from all evil. Every evil intention against me is canceled. Every evil plan against me is frustrated. Every evil covenant against me is broken. Every evil pronouncement against me is reversed. I am preserved from all evil. You preserve my soul. My mind is protected, my emotions are guarded, my will is strengthened. I shall not be depressed, I shall not be anxious, I shall not be tormented. My soul is kept in perfect peace. You preserve my going out and my coming in from this time forth and even forevermore. Every journey I make is protected, every venture I begin is blessed, every seed I plant is multiplied. Every harvest I reap is preserved. This is not temporary, this is eternal. This is not seasonal, this is perpetual. From this moment forward and throughout eternity, I am kept by the power of God. In Jesus' mighty name I pray. Amen. Now, I want you to carry this word with you throughout the day. I want you to meditate on it. I want you to chew on it. I want you to digest it. Let it become part of your spiritual DNA. Let it saturate your consciousness. Let it permeate your thinking. And remember what I said at the beginning. Share this message. Don't keep it to yourself. [music] There is power in distribution. There is multiplication in sharing. When you share this word, you are not just blessing someone else. You are positioning yourself for greater blessing. When you become a channel of blessing, you attract more blessing into your own life. The scripture says in Luke 6:38, "Give, and it shall be given unto you. Good measure, pressed down and shaken together and running over shall men give into your bosom." When you give out this word, when you share this message, when you distribute this blessing, >> [music] >> you are activating the law of reciprocity. You are setting in motion the principle of multiplication. You are establishing the dynamic of divine [music] return. So, right now, take a moment and share this message with at least three people. Send it to your family group. [music] Post it on your timeline. Forward it to your friends. Let this word spread. Let this declaration multiply. Let this proclamation increase because someone needs to hear this. Someone is under attack and they need this covering. Someone is in crisis [music] and they need this protection. Someone is facing challenges and they need this preservation. And as you share, declare over your own life. As I have freely received, I freely give. As I distribute this blessing, I attract [music] more blessing. As I share this word, I receive more word. My cup runs over. My bottle does not run dry. My cruise of oil does not fail. I am blessed to be a blessing. And as I bless others, I am blessed in return. Before I close this word, I want to give you a prophetic instruction. For the next 21 days, I want you to declare Psalm 121 every morning. Not just once, declare it at least three times every morning. Speak it over your life, speak it over your family, speak it over your business, speak it over your ministry, speak it over your health, speak it over your finances. And watch what God will do. Watch how atmospheres will shift. Watch how circumstances will change. [music] Watch how challenges will resolve. Watch how breakthrough will manifest. Watch how testimonies will emerge. Watch God work in your life in ways you have never experienced before. This is not a formula. This is not a magic incantation. This is a spiritual principle. This is a kingdom dynamic. This is a divine strategy. When you consistently declare the word of God over your life, you create an environment where miracles become normal, where breakthroughs become regular, where testimonies become constant. And I prophesy over you, from this day forward, [music] you shall not be the same. From this moment onward, you shall not walk in defeat. From this time forth, you shall not live in fear. You are stepping into a new dimension of divine protection. You are entering a new level of supernatural preservation. You are accessing a new realm of heavenly security. The Lord is your keeper. The Lord is your shade. The Lord is your protector. The Lord is your defender. The Lord is your fortress. The Lord is your strong tower. The Lord is your rock. The Lord is your shield. The Lord is your buckler. The Lord is your high tower. And as you go forth from this moment, you go with the assurance that you are kept by the power of God. You are preserved by the hand of God. You are covered by the blood of Jesus. You are sealed by the Holy Spirit. You are protected by the angels of God. You are surrounded by the presence of God. No weapon formed against you shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn. This is your heritage as a servant of the Lord, and your righteousness is of God. You are blessed in the city and blessed in the field. You are blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out. The Lord shall command the blessing upon you in your storehouse and in all that you set your hand to do. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in protection. Go in preservation. Go in the assurance that the Lord who keeps you neither slumbers nor sleeps. From this time forth and even forevermore. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Amen and amen.
